title: File:Krak des Chevaliers, Inner and outer walls, Syria.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Krak des Chevaliers, a Crusader castle in Syria, one of the most important preserved medieval castles in the world. The castle sits atop a 650-m-high hill east of Tartus, Syria, in the Homs Gap, Talkalakh.
